For a security problem, use the Security tab's "Report a vulnerability" instead
of a public issue.

Do not attach recordings, transcripts, or screenshots that show personal information.

If you want to attach the diagnostic log, press Windows+R, enter
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Dusty\logs`, and attach only `dusty.log`. Do not attach settings
or unfinished-work files. Review every attachment before posting.

## Dusty version

Find the version in Help > About Dusty.

## Windows version

Press Windows+R, enter `winver`, and type the Windows version shown.

## What happened?

What did you try, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
Include the plain error text if one appeared. Leave out private file paths.
